name: Focused Defense
body:
Your dedicated study in one school of magic has made you less susceptible to it.

Prerequisite(s): Spell Focus, Spellcraft 3 ranks.

Benefit: You gain a +2 bonus on saves and armor class against spells from schools you’ve chosen with Spell Focus.
